results.description:
Need a List is the simplest way to catalog everything you collect.

Whatever it is — coffee mugs, watches, action figures, vinyl records, sneakers, trading cards, wine — make a list for it. Add each item with photos, a description, its value, tags, and your own custom fields. Then find anything in seconds.

MAKE A LIST FOR ANYTHING
• A separate collection for each thing you collect, each with its own icon and color
• Add items with multiple photos from your camera or library
• Describe them with notes, quantity, value, and tags

YOUR OWN FIELDS
• Define custom fields per collection — Brand, Year, Condition, Artist, anything
• Every item in that collection can fill them in

FIND IT FAST
• Search across every collection by name, tag, description, or custom field
• No barcode? Search by photo — the app finds the closest-looking items you own, entirely on your device
• Ask Siri: "Do I own this?" — answered from your own catalog, hands-free
• Items are indexed in Spotlight, so you can search right from your Home Screen
• Sort by date, name, value, or favorites; filter by owned, wishlist, favorites, or for-trade

OWNED & WISHLIST
• Track what you already have and what you're still hunting for
• Mark duplicates "for trade" and share a HAVE/WANT list
• Star your favorites

KNOW WHAT IT'S WORTH
• Record what you paid and what it's worth now — every revaluation is kept as history
• See your gain per item and across your whole collection
• Attach receipts, certificates, and appraisals to items
• Export a photo-rich insurance report (PDF) of everything you own

CATALOG FASTER
• Shelf capture: photograph a whole shelf and each item becomes its own entry
• Scan a barcode to auto-fill details from items you've catalogued before
• Switching apps? Import your Discogs, Goodreads, CLZ, or iCollect export in one tap

ORGANIZE THE REAL WORLD
• Record where each item lives — shelf, box, room
• Print QR labels for your storage boxes; scanning a label shows exactly what's inside

SEE THE BIG PICTURE
• Totals and the combined value of each collection at a glance

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your collection counts
• An Apple Watch app for a glance at your wrist
• Runs on iPhone, iPad (with a full sidebar layout), and Mac
• Keyboard shortcuts and drag-and-drop photo import on iPad and Mac

CELEBRATE IT
• Collection Wrapped: shareable year-in-review cards of your collecting year

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Pay once, own it forever — no subscription, no accounts, no ads, no tracking
• Your collections stay on your device and sync only through your own private iCloud
• Optional Face ID lock for valuable collections
• Your data is always yours: CSV export, full backups, and a shareable web-page export of any collection

Start your first list today.
